name: Áurea (Brazil)
description: Divided into four sectors of white, light blue, yellow and green by diagonal lines radiating from the upper hoist corner.
history: Áurea is a municipality in the state of Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, settled by Polish immigrants and named after the Golden Law that abolished slavery. Flags of the World records that the flag and arms were prescribed by Municipal Law No. 79 of 5 March 1990 and that the flag is charged at the centre with the municipal arms; the Wikimedia Commons drawing omits them.
